description:
A single Pinterest pin by URL or ID: title, description, image/video, outbound link, engagement counts, board and pinner.
Cost: 1 credit per successful call (failed calls are refunded).
Provide one of: `url` OR `id`.
Returns: id (string), link (string), title (string), description (string), alt_text (string, nullable), dominant_color (string, nullable), image_url (string, nullable), image_width (integer, nullable), image_height (integer, nullable), is_video (boolean), video_url (string, nullable), video_duration_ms (integer, nullable), repin_count (integer, nullable), reaction_count (integer, nullable), comment_count (integer, nullable), favorite_count (integer, nullable), share_count (integer, nullable), outbound_link (string, nullable), outbound_domain (string, nullable), created_at (string, nullable), board_name (string, nullable), board_url (string, nullable), pinner_username (string, nullable), pinner_full_name (string, nullable), pinner_image_url (string, nullable).

id.description: Numeric pin ID; used only when url is empty. Example: "142567144449027286"

url.description: Pin URL (a bare pin ID also works). Example: "https://www.pinterest.com/pin/142567144449027286/"

name: pinterest_pin
title: Pinterest pin
